not_run_reasons: Source training HELP support is 2; at least 5 genuine completed pairs required.
Source training HURT support is 0; at least 5 genuine completed pairs required.
Source predictor fitting has not run.

probabilities: Uncalibrated three-class classifier outputs, not correctness probabilities.
limitations: Five genuine source-training examples per outcome class is only an eligibility floor, not evidence of research reliability. Class weights create no new rare events.

Frozen explicit-final-v1 normalization uses Decimal precision 28. Only exact finite decimal values and fractions exactly representable at that precision are accepted as reliable numeric evidence. This validation does not relabel records; precision-preserving grading needs a new version.

Policy tokens and reconstructed latency use the successful initial/recheck calls of completed pairs. They exclude failed/retried call work and its unknown token usage; collection elapsed time and failure counts must be reported separately. They are not complete collection cost or measured live end-to-end latency.

predeclared.model_selection_rule: Fit on source training only. Select the highest question-equal source-development macro-F1; ties (12 decimal places) use lower question-equal multiclass log loss, then the fixed candidate order. No target labels are used for model selection.
predeclared.threshold_selection_rule: Question-equal HELP minus HURT utility on source development only; ties use fewer recorded recheck tokens, then the larger threshold. Strict score > threshold.

backend.parameters:
repeat_penalty                 1
stop                           "<|im_start|>"
stop                           "<|im_end|>"
temperature                    0.6
top_k                          20
top_p                          0.95

prompts.initial: Solve the question independently. Give a brief explanation. Finish with FINAL: followed by only the numeric answer or the option letter, as appropriate.
prompts.recheck: Recheck the saved initial response against the same original question. Keep its answer if justified; change it only if you identify an error. Give a brief explanation. Finish with FINAL: followed by only the numeric answer or option letter.
prompts.initial_messages: one user: initial prompt + two newlines + original question
prompts.recheck_messages: same initial user; assistant: full saved initial response; user: recheck prompt

parser.numeric: explicit FINAL marker; finite decimal/fraction; comma/currency normalization
parser.choice: explicit FINAL marker; single A-E option letter; optional parentheses/punctuation
parser.unparseable: record parsing failure; completed call scored incorrect offline

grader.numeric: exact Decimal equality; no floating tolerance
grader.keys: separate offline file; never in call or feature inputs

transport.ambiguous_started_calls: block resume until operator resolves; never silently repeat
transport.session_budget: do not start calls after deadline; bound each call by remaining time

live_study_protocol.sampling: one initial call and one separate recheck per question; offline recheck EVERY question
live_study_protocol.runtime_treatment: no warm-up call; first-call cold load included; backend caching uncontrolled and actual durations logged

historical_comparison.difference: new pinned Thinking-2507 local checkpoint, explicit prompts/decoding, 1024-token calls, no finalizer; independent study

numeric_precision_audit.scope: All successful journal responses, including calls not yet forming a completed pair.
